mapper.sql: n.use_yn = 'Y' and (n.cust_id is null or n.cust_id = s.cust_id) and (n.item_class_id is null or n.item_class_id = i.item_class_id) and (n.item_id is null or n.item_id = l.item_id)
exists (select 1 from wms_ship_note_ack a where a.ship_id = s.ship_id and a.note_id = n.note_id and a.note_ver = n.row_ver)

n.note_id, n.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, n.item_class_id, k.class_cd, k.class_nm, n.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, n.title, n.body, n.ack_required_yn, n.use_yn, n.sort_no, n.row_ver, n.updated_at, n.updated_by
from wms_ship_note n left join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = n.cust_id left join mst_item_class k on k.class_id = n.item_class_id left join mst_item i on i.item_id = n.item_id
mapper.select:
select order by
n.title c.cust_cd n.updated_at n.sort_no
desc,
n.note_id limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select class_id, class_cd, class_nm from mst_item_class where use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, class_cd
select cust_id from mst_cust where cust_cd = #{custCd} and cust_type in ('SALES', 'BOTH')
select class_id from mst_item_class where class_cd = #{classCd}
select item_id from mst_item where item_cd = #{itemCd}

insert into wms_ship_note (comp_cd, cust_id, item_class_id, item_id, title, body, ack_required_yn, use_yn, sort_no, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.custId}, #{f.itemClassId}, #{f.itemId}, #{f.title}, #{f.body}, #{f.ackRequiredYn}, #{f.useYn}, #{f.sortNo}, #{by}, #{by}) returning note_id

select n.note_id, n.title, n.body, n.ack_required_yn, n.row_ver as note_ver, c.cust_cd, k.class_cd, ni.item_cd, l.ship_line_id, a.acked_at, a.acked_by, w.worker_nm as ack_worker_nm from wms_ship s join wms_ship_line l on l.ship_id = s.ship_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id join wms_ship_note n on left join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = n.cust_id left join mst_item_class k on k.class_id = n.item_class_id left join mst_item ni on ni.item_id = n.item_id left join wms_ship_note_ack a on a.ship_id = s.ship_id and a.note_id = n.note_id and a.note_ver = n.row_ver left join mst_worker w on w.worker_id = a.worker_id where s.ship_id = #{shipId} order by n.sort_no, n.note_id, l.line_no
mapper.insert: insert into wms_ship_note_ack (comp_cd, ship_id, note_id, note_ver, worker_id, acked_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{shipId}, #{noteId}, #{noteVer}, #{workerId}, #{by}) on conflict (ship_id, note_id, note_ver) do nothing
